title: Authorising the Deposit on a Resort Lodging Reservation
content:
Where a deposit falls due on a Resort Lodging reservation, the household itself authorises it and has it taken. A deposit entry for the amount authorised is written to that reservation's folio against the payment route named, and the deposit standing against the reservation rises by that amount. The household sees the deposit line on the folio and the deposit held on the reservation go up by what they authorised, with the money taken from the route they named.

## Whose act it is

The act is the household's own, not the desk's. The tool `authorise_reservation_deposit_3e63cb2f` is unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it; the reference number of the reservation is read from the record the desk has on screen and given to the household.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lodging_id` | the reference number identifying the Resort Lodging reservation the deposit is authorised on; it is read from the reservation record the desk has on screen and given to the household |
| `deposit_amount_usd` | the deposit the household authorises, in USD, as a decimal amount rounded to 2 decimal places; a value carrying more decimals is taken rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | where the money is taken from |

The value of `payment_method` is one of exactly these: `card_on_file`, used where it is taken from the card the household already has registered with the collective; `card_at_desk`, used where the household presents a card in person; `bank_transfer`, used where the household sends the money from their bank; `lodging_credit`, used where the household spends lodging credit it already holds; `travel_partner`, used where a travel partner settles on the household's behalf; and `none`, which records no money route at all and is reserved for folio entries that move no money.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence on success, carrying the reference number of the folio entry created, the deposit amount in USD authorised, the route the money was taken from and the deposit now standing against the reservation. Receiving that sentence, with a folio entry reference in it, is what indicates the deposit has been taken.
